beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A research consortium can exist legally while its collaborative activity has effectively stopped.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Conversely, a functioning collaboration can persist through substantial changes in membership.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book uses such cases to question one universal account of identity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Process continuity and collective coordination need criteria appropriate to what is being studied.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Those criteria must remain explicit enough for disagreement and independent evaluation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A convenient label cannot establish that a new mathematical primitive is necessary.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This example extends the proposal beyond numbers without pretending the problem is solved.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It gives readers a demanding test of the relationship between formalization and interpretation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Executable science would connect claims, assumptions, methods, data, and revisable theory objects.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Artificial intelligence could help propose translations and coordinate existing verification tools.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A translation can nevertheless become formally valid while changing the original scientific meaning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book identifies that semantic drift as a central danger.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A small checking kernel cannot recover an intention that was mistranslated upstream.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The architecture therefore needs source alignment and review alongside machine-checkable evidence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Existing theorem provers and analysis tools should be integrated where they already work.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed layer must justify its additional value through complete scientific workflows.
